content.title: 300/500 Assisted Promotional Housing
summary: The completed 300-home phase of a 500-home LPA programme in Douaouda, comprising R+8 apartment blocks, professional premises, external works, and full TCE delivery.

The Douaouda development comprises the completed 300-home phase of a 500-home assisted promotional housing programme in a coastal setting, combining residential units with professional premises and external works.
description: Igloo delivered the project with full TCE scope, encompassing reinforced concrete works, secondary trades, MEP coordination, external access, and finishes.
The R+8 blocks combine F3 and F4 layouts with ground-floor professional uses, creating a residential environment that is practical, well-ventilated, and connected to daily services.
content.authority: A coastal residential programme delivered with the discipline of a comprehensive site operation: structure, services, circulation, and finishes integrated as a unified whole.

hero.alt: A wide shot of a large construction site with several multi-story concrete residential buildings in various stages of structural completion. A tall tower crane is visible in the background, extending over the buildings. The ground is reddish-brown dirt, and the sky is overcast.
hero.caption: Structural work in progress on residential buildings.

hero.alt: A vertical shot of a construction site under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, red-brown excavated earth and some green vegetation. In the midground, a tall, grey concrete structure (likely a core) with red formwork at the top, and to its right, another multi-story building with concrete frames and red brick infill. A large blue tower crane with 'UNEN COMANSA' visible on its boom extends across the sky. Below the crane, a concrete pump truck and two cement mixer trucks are visible. In the far background, the blue sea is visible.
hero.caption: Structural works underway at the Douaouda residential project.

intro.alt: An aerial shot showing several large, beige apartment blocks with brown roofs, surrounded by unpaved ground and some construction materials. Older, smaller buildings are in the foreground, and a body of water is visible in the distant background under a cloudy sky.
intro.caption: Newly completed residential buildings in Douaouda.

mosaic.alt: Several multi-story residential apartment buildings with light-colored facades and brown accents, viewed from a low angle. The foreground is a dirt construction site with piles of sand, bricks, and white bags. An overcast sky is visible above the buildings.
mosaic.caption: Newly completed residential buildings with ongoing site work.
